description: This file defines the KendraRankingClient class used to interact with the Amazon Kendra Intelligent Ranking service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, describing, listing, rescoring, tagging, and updating rescore execution plans, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: KendraRankingClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon Kendra Intelligent Ranking service, extending the generic AwsClient with specific service methods.

methods.name: createRescoreExecutionPlan
methods.description: Creates a new rescore execution plan for Amazon Kendra Intelligent Ranking.

methods.name: deleteRescoreExecutionPlan
methods.description: Deletes an existing rescore execution plan.

methods.name: describeRescoreExecutionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific rescore execution plan.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a specified resource.

methods.name: updateRescoreExecutionPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing rescore execution plan.
